comment: Blocked setup: this Wizard wish of a nonpetrifying Rider corpse is accepted into inventory by C invent.c:hold_another_object, but the current JS hold_another_object stops at its broader wished-corpse refusal before apply.c:use_tinning_kit can run. The active use_tinning_kit inventory-Rider arm also consumes do.c:revive_corpse's Boolean result; js/do.js covers only the floor shape and js/zap.js:revive does not yet cover inventory revival coordinates/flags. Keep this recipe unrecorded and the Rider entry point incomplete until both source boundaries are implemented and replayed.
